title: Windows-Native Lock Recovery

evidence.summary: Linux Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 passed; Windows-native failed one abandoned same-host lock recovery test.

evidence.name: windows-native
evidence.root_cause: ProcessFileLock._pid_alive used os.kill(pid, 0); on Windows the impossible PID was not classified as dead, preventing stale same-host lock reclamation.

evidence.claim: Added Windows-native PID liveness detection using OpenProcess/GetExitCodeProcess while preserving conservative fail-safe behavior.
Added explicit tests for current-process liveness and impossible-PID death detection.
Checkpoint-0050 multiprocess crash/recovery, queue-writer and transaction-writer tests all passed on Windows before the unrelated abandoned-lock test failed.
